The System Administrator II will be responsible for supporting the smooth and reliable day-to-day operation of customer on-premises and cloud-based systems. The System Administrator II will work closely with customers, project teams, and internal stakeholders to maintain system stability, support operational needs, and deliver secure, high-availability technology solutions. How You'll Make an Impac t Ensure system security through the administration of access controls, backup processes, and security best practices. Configure, maintain, and manage user access for assigned projects and operational environments. Research, evaluate, and recommend hardware, software, and infrastructure improvements to support business and operational needs. Monitor and assess operating system performance, performing routine updates, upgrades, patches, and system modifications. Administer and maintain server hardware, operating systems, and associated software platforms. Develop and maintain technical documentation, user guides, and support materials for training and operational purposes. Manage secure network connectivity and remote access solutions for remote users and distributed teams. Conduct system security audits and support compliance initiatives to ensure adherence to organizational and customer requirements. Manage the onboarding, relocation, replacement, and retirement of IT equipment and assets. Implement, administer, and monitor identity, governance, storage, compute, and virtual networking services within Microsoft Azure environments. Provision, size, monitor, optimize, and adjust cloud resources across multiple infrastructure projects. Implement and maintain Windows-based security controls, including user and group permissions, file and folder permissions, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), and local security policies. Analyze, identify, and implement system enhancements, upgrades, and technical solutions to improve platform performance, reliability, security, and supportability. Ensure compliance with customer corporate policies through reporting, audits, and compliance management programs. Provide technical support for system validations, testing activities, and change management initiatives. Work closely with System Engineers and Project Managers to ensure best practices are applied throughout system design, implementation, and operational support phases. Create, maintain, and track physical and logical inventories of servers and related infrastructure assets. Support multiple customers, projects, and environments, balancing operational priorities and project requirements. Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned. Ability to identify, prioritize, track, and successfully complete tasks across multiple projects while meeting established deadlines. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Active Directory, PowerShell, SharePoint, and Microsoft Office Suite. Experience installing, configuring, and maintaining operating systems, server hardware, and related infrastructure components. Experience monitoring system performance and maintaining environments using tools such as Nagios, Splunk, and other infrastructure monitoring solutions. Working knowledge of Linux operating systems and open-source technologies. Strong experience supporting and administering Windows server and desktop operating systems. Experience with virtualization technologies, including VMware and Microsoft Hyper-V. Experience managing user accounts, permissions, and access rights within enterprise environments. Familiarity with developing, implementing, and supporting backup and disaster recovery strategies and plans. Experience performing system upgrades, patching activities, and deployments of new software releases and hardware platforms. Ability to develop technical expertise and provide training and guidance to end users and technical staff on new technologies and processes. Understanding of data privacy, security, and compliance standards, including PCI-DSS and SOC frameworks. Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure services, workloads, identity management, security, governance, networking, and cloud administration principles. Experience with databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL, as well as networking concepts including LAN, WAN, and patch management processes. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Professional certifications such as Microsoft Certified Systems Administrator (MCSA), Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, or equivalent cloud and infrastructure certifications are highly desirable. What We Offer The opportunity to solve complex problems that improve the daily lives of people around the world. Career growth, stability, and the opportunity to develop within a global organization. A competitive annual compensation range of $81,000 – $110,000, based on experience, skills, internal equity, and market data. A full benefits package, including unlimited paid time off, 11 paid holidays, 401(k), a no-cost medical insurance option for employees and eligible dependents, and an FSA option. Become part of our team and drive innovation in mobility. A Note on How We Use AI: We believe hiring is a human decision.
